title: 법무부감찰위원회 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00006:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 6 (Meetings of the Committee)
(1) The Committee shall operate through regular meetings held once every quarter and extraordinary meetings held where deemed necessary by the chairperson or upon request by the Minister of Justice or at least one third of its members.
(2) Meetings of the Committee shall be convened and presided over by the chairperson.
(3) Where a resolution is necessary on a matter for discussion, the Committee shall adopt the resolution with the attendance of a majority of its members and the affirmative vote of a majority of the members present: Provided, That where opinions are divided on a disciplinary matter concerning a person subject to an inspection or audit and no opinion obtains a majority of the members present, the more favorable opinions shall be successively added to the opinion most disadvantageous to the person until the combined opinions constitute a majority of the members present, and the most favorable opinion among those combined shall be deemed the agreed opinion. <Amended on April 28, 2020>
(4) Meetings of the Committee shall not be open to the public.
